name: RepresentUs Education Fund
summary: The 501(c)(3) arm of RepresentUs, the nonpartisan US anti-corruption and democracy-reform group (its Education Fund incorporated in 2008 as the Change Congress Forum; Represent.Us itself is a 501(c)(4), and gifts to it aren't tax-deductible). The Education Fund runs RepresentUs's national videos and social media on corruption and threats to democracy, education and volunteer outreach behind state and local ballot measures (ranked-choice voting, independent redistricting commissions, anti-corruption laws), research, and the American Democracy Summit, and grants to Represent.Us for its campaign outreach. In 2024 it spent $7.8 million.

spending.source: https://represent.us/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/RUEF-24-FS-Final-1-2.pdf (audited statements of Represent.Us Education Fund, year ended December 31 2024, p. 5, statement of activities: total program services $4,736,360 of $7,760,781 total expenses; Represent.Us, the 501(c)(4), files its own statements and is left out)

lines.label: Education and communications, Other projects, Awards and grants, and Research and planning
